lawn-maintenance.local_h: Mowing Hallsville's mix of lots and acreage
local: Hallsville is really two kinds of yard. In town and the newer subdivisions you get standard lots with a line of pines or hardwoods along the back. Farther out, the lots open up into acreage that runs against pasture or woods. We price weekly mowing to the actual ground, from $65 a visit on a neighborhood lot, with acreage quoted after we walk it. Tell us which kind you have and roughly how much of it needs mowing, and the written price comes back with the per-visit number already in it.

Most Hallsville lawns are two grasses in one yard: bermuda where it is open and sunny, St. Augustine where the tree lines throw shade. We set the deck for each one instead of splitting the difference. Bermuda runs around two inches through summer, and St. Augustine stays at three and a half to four. On acreage we use a mower sized for the ground and trim along fences and ditch lines.

The ground changes inside a single Hallsville property. Higher spots are sandy and dry out fast in July. Low spots sit on heavier clay that holds water after a hard rain. If a low spot stays soft for days, that is a drainage question and not a mowing one, and we will tell you so when we walk the property.

Pines and hardwoods along the back and side lines drop needles and leaves from fall into winter. Early fall leaves get mulched back into the lawn on our mowing visits. If the tree line is heavy, a full leaf cleanup is a separate service we can quote alongside the mowing. Hallsville sits between Longview and Marshall, so we run it with our other jobs along US 80.

faq.q: Can you mow acreage outside Hallsville, or just neighborhood lots?
faq.a: Both. Neighborhood lots usually start at $65 per visit for weekly mowing. Acreage gets priced after we walk it, since the size, the obstacles and how much trimming there is along fences and tree lines all change the time it takes.

faq.q: What height will you mow my Hallsville lawn?
faq.a: It depends on the grass. Bermuda runs about one to one and a half inches in spring and two to two and a half in summer. St. Augustine stays at three and a half to four inches all summer. If your yard has sunny bermuda and a shaded St. Augustine section, we cut each at its own height.

faq.q: Why is part of my Hallsville yard still wet days after rain?
faq.a: Newer homes sit on graded pads, and once the topsoil settles a flat backyard can hold water after a hard rain. Low spots also sit on heavier clay. Often the fix is regrading, a swale and a pop-up emitter, well before anyone needs a French drain. We look at where the water goes when we walk the yard.

faq.q: What does weekly mowing in Hallsville depend on?
faq.a: Lot size, weekly or bi-weekly schedule, how much trimming and edging there is, heavy tree cover and gate access. You get a flat per-visit price in writing before the first mow. Heavy shade and long fence lines add trimming time, which is why two lots the same size can price differently.

faq.q: Do you mow in Harleton and along US 80?
faq.a: Yes. We work around Hallsville, Harleton and the stretch of US 80 between Longview and Marshall. Send your address with a quote request and we will confirm the schedule.
